annotations.title: Was this tax/e-invoice code valid on a date?

description: 1 call per code. Checks whether an official code-list entry was in force on a date, from the authorities' own published files: Brazil NF-e (NCM, CFOP, cClassTrib, CST, CSOSN...), Mexico SAT CFDI 4.0 and 3.3 catalogs (c_UsoCFDI, c_ClaveProdServ, c_RegimenFiscal...), Poland KSeF FA(2)/FA(3) lists (TStawkaPodatku, TKodKraju, TGTU...). Answers status valid / expired / not_yet_valid / never_existed / not_covered with valid_from/valid_to, table version, source file link and receipt id. Send either one check (country, table, code, date) or 'checks' (list, max 100).

checks.description: Optional batch instead of the single fields: list of {country, table, code, date}.

code.description: The code as written on the invoice; dots and spaces are ignored (8471.30.12 = 84713012).

date.description: The date that matters (issue date) as YYYY-MM-DD.

table.description: Official table name, e.g. ncm, cfop, cclasstrib, cst_icms (BR); c_UsoCFDI, c_ClaveProdServ, c_RegimenFiscal, c_ClaveUnidad (MX, add @3.3 for the CFDI 3.3 catalog); TStawkaPodatku, TKodKraju, TKodWaluty, TGTU (PL). The coverage tool lists all tables.
